LOANS.CONFIRM_WRITE_OFF: This will write off the remaining balance of this loan. This action cannot be undone.
LOANS.CONFIRM_FORECLOSURE: This will close the loan early by settling the full outstanding balance as of the transaction date. This action cannot be undone.
LOANS.CONFIRM_CLOSE: This will mark the loan as closed. This action cannot be undone.
LOANS.CONFIRM_UNDO_DISBURSAL: This will reverse the disbursement and return the loan to Approved status.
LOANS.CONFIRM_DELETE_LOAN: Are you sure you want to delete this loan application? This action cannot be undone.
LOANS.CONFIRM_DELETE_COLLATERAL: Are you sure you want to delete this collateral? This action cannot be undone.
LOANS.CONFIRM_ADJUST_TRANSACTION: This will reverse the original transaction and record a new one with the corrected details. This action cannot be undone.
LOANS.NO_NOTES: No notes recorded for this loan yet.
LOANS.CONFIRM_DELETE_NOTE: Are you sure you want to delete this note? This action cannot be undone.
LOANS.NO_DOCUMENTS: No documents attached to this loan yet.
LOANS.CONFIRM_DELETE_DOCUMENT: Are you sure you want to delete this document? This action cannot be undone.
LOANS.CONFIRM_CHARGE_OFF: Charge off this loan? The balance moves out of performing assets for reporting, and collection continues. This is not a write-off.
LOANS.CONFIRM_UNDO_CHARGE_OFF: Undo the charge-off? The loan returns to being reported as a performing asset.
LOANS.CONFIRM_UNDO_WRITE_OFF: Undo the write-off? The loan returns to being an active receivable.
LOANS.CONFIRM_RE_AGE: Re-age this loan? Overdue instalments are folded into a new schedule, giving the borrower a fresh start on the arrears.
LOANS.CONFIRM_RE_AMORTIZE: Re-amortise this loan? The outstanding balance is spread across the remaining instalments.
LOANS.CONFIRM_UNDO_APPROVAL: This returns the loan to pending approval. The approved amount and approval date are cleared, and the loan has to be approved again before it can be disbursed.
LOANS.CONFIRM_CLOSE_AS_RESCHEDULED: This closes the loan on the basis that it has been rescheduled onto a new loan. The outstanding balance is not written off and no further repayment is expected on this account.
LOANS.CONFIRM_UNASSIGN_LOAN_OFFICER: The loan stops counting towards this officer from the date you choose. Backdate it to the day they actually stopped, or every report for the period in between will still credit them.
LOANS.CONFIRM_UNDO_LAST_DISBURSAL: This reverses the most recent tranche released on this loan. The schedule is recalculated without it.

HELP.TRANSACTION_PROCESSING_STRATEGY_DESC: The order in which a repayment is applied to what the borrower owes. Progressive products must use Advanced Payment Allocation, which is why the field is fixed for them.
HELP.LOAN_SCHEDULE_PROCESSING_TYPE_DESC: How a payment moves through unpaid instalments. Horizontal settles one instalment fully before moving to the next; Vertical pays the same component across every instalment first. Progressive products only.
HELP.PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_DESC: For each kind of incoming payment, the order in which it clears what is owed. The list is applied top to bottom until the payment is used up.
HELP.CREDIT_ALLOCATION_DESC: The same ordering, for credits such as refunds and goodwill adjustments rather than borrower repayments.
HELP.MULTI_DISBURSE_LOAN_DESC: Pay the loan out in stages rather than all at once — used where money is released against progress, such as construction or working capital. Each release is called a tranche.
HELP.MAX_TRANCHE_COUNT_DESC: The largest number of separate releases allowed on one loan. Officers cannot add more tranches than this.
HELP.DISALLOW_EXPECTED_DISBURSEMENTS_DESC: Leave unticked to require the full tranche plan — how much, and when — to be entered when the loan is created. Tick it to let tranches be added as they are actually needed.
HELP.DOWN_PAYMENT_PERCENTAGE_DESC: How much of the disbursed amount the borrower pays upfront, as a percentage. 20 on a 1,000 disbursement means a 200 down payment and 800 repaid over the schedule.
HELP.AUTO_REPAYMENT_FOR_DOWN_PAYMENT_DESC: Record the down payment for the borrower as soon as the loan is disbursed. Leave unticked if it is collected separately and should be entered by hand.
HELP.ENABLE_INCOME_CAPITALIZATION_DESC: Recognise income gradually over the loan's term instead of all at once when it is charged. The borrower pays the same either way — this changes when the institution books the income. Progressive products only.
HELP.CAPITALIZED_INCOME_TYPE_DESC: Whether the amount being spread is treated as a fee or as interest. This decides which income account it lands in and how it appears on the loan.
HELP.ENABLE_BUY_DOWN_FEE_DESC: Let someone other than the borrower — typically a dealer or supplier — pay an amount upfront to reduce the borrower's effective rate. The cost is spread over the term rather than taken in full at disbursement. Progressive products only.
HELP.BUY_DOWN_FEE_INCOME_TYPE_DESC: Whether the amount the third party paid is booked as a fee or as interest.
HELP.INCOME_CALCULATION_TYPE_DESC: How the amount to recognise in each period is worked out. Flat divides the total evenly rather than varying it with the outstanding balance.
HELP.INCOME_STRATEGY_DESC: How the total is distributed across the loan's periods. Equal parts gives every period the same share.
HELP.INTEREST_RECALCULATION_DESC: Charge interest on what the borrower actually owes on the day, rather than on the balance the original schedule assumed. A borrower who pays early then pays less interest, and one who pays late pays more. Leave off for a schedule fixed at disbursement.
HELP.COMPOUNDING_METHOD_DESC: Which unpaid amounts are added to the balance that interest is charged on — none, interest only, fees, or both. Choosing none still recalculates interest, it simply does not compound what is outstanding.
HELP.RESCHEDULE_STRATEGY_DESC: What to adjust when recalculation changes the amount owed: keep the instalment the same and change how many there are, reduce the instalment, or adjust the final one.
HELP.REST_FREQUENCY_DESC: How often the balance is re-examined. Daily reacts to every payment; matching the repayment period recalculates once per instalment.
HELP.REST_INTERVAL_DESC: How many of those periods pass between recalculations. Only needed when the frequency is something other than the repayment period.
HELP.COMPOUNDING_FREQUENCY_DESC: How often the amounts chosen above are folded into the balance interest is charged on.
HELP.COMPOUNDING_INTERVAL_DESC: How many of those periods pass between compounding. Only needed when the frequency is something other than the repayment period.
HELP.PRE_CLOSURE_STRATEGY_DESC: How much interest to charge when a borrower settles early — up to the settlement date, or to the end of the current period.
HELP.CHARGE_OFF_BEHAVIOUR_DESC: What happens to interest once the loan is written off as uncollectible: carry on as normal, stop accruing, or treat the loan as matured immediately.
HELP.REPAYMENT_START_DATE_TYPE_DESC: Whether the repayment schedule counts from the date the loan was approved for disbursement or the date the money actually went out.
HELP.FIXED_LENGTH_DESC: Force every loan on this product to run for the same number of periods, regardless of the amount borrowed. Leave empty for a term set per loan.
HELP.ACCRUAL_ACTIVITY_POSTING_DESC: Post an accounting entry each time interest or fees accrue, rather than only when they are charged or paid. Gives finance a running view at the cost of more journal entries.
HELP.CHARGE_OFF_DESC: Charging off moves the outstanding balance out of performing assets for reporting, while the institution carries on trying to collect. It is not the same as a write-off, which means giving up on recovery. A charged-off loan stays active.
HELP.CHARGE_OFF_REASON_DESC: Why the loan is being charged off. Recorded against the transaction for audit and reporting. Optional, and only offered when your institution has configured reasons.
HELP.OPENING_BALANCES_DESC: Carry the balances from your previous ledger into this one. Only available before the first journal entry is posted for the office.
HELP.FREQUENT_POSTINGS_DESC: Post a journal entry from a saved accounting rule, so recurring postings need only an amount and a date.
HELP.REPORT_DEFINITIONS_DESC: The catalogue behind the Reporting section: the SQL each report runs, the parameters it takes, and whether it is offered to users.
HELP.WORK_QUEUES_DESC: The approvals a branch works through together: pending loans, loans awaiting disbursal, pending clients and reschedule requests. Each action is sent as one batch, and any record the platform refuses is named.

GUIDE.DASHBOARD_WELCOME_DESC: This guide will walk you through the key areas of the dashboard and how to navigate the backoffice application.
GUIDE.DASHBOARD_ENV_DESC: Here you can monitor the health of the connected Fineract environment, active tenant, and check runtime API configurations.
GUIDE.CLIENTS_DESC: Manage client files, profile details, and linked financial accounts. From here you can create new client registrations.
GUIDE.CLIENTS_SEARCH_DESC: Use this field to quickly filter client records by name, account number, or status.
GUIDE.CLIENTS_CREATE_DESC: Click here to add a new client to the backoffice registry.
GUIDE.CLIENTS_VIEW_DESC: View details about this client, including activation dates, contact details, and their linked financial accounts.
GUIDE.CLIENTS_VIEW_TABS_DESC: Switch between tabs to see the client's Loan Accounts, Savings Accounts, and Share Accounts.
GUIDE.CLIENTS_VIEW_ACTIONS_DESC: Use these buttons to perform operations like client profile editing, account creation, or state transitions.
GUIDE.LOANS_DESC: Track outstanding loan applications, disbursements, and repayments.
GUIDE.LOANS_FILTER_DESC: Filter loan accounts by status, office, staff, or search directly by client or account number.
GUIDE.LOANS_VIEW_DESC: Examine loan summary details, repayment schedules, and transaction histories.
GUIDE.LOANS_VIEW_TABS_DESC: Explore loan details across different tabs such as summary, repayment schedule, transactions, and charges.
GUIDE.SAVINGS_VIEW_DESC: Monitor savings account balance, transaction histories, and compounding options.
GUIDE.SAVINGS_VIEW_TABS_DESC: Switch tabs to view summary, transactions, charges, or linked accounts.
GUIDE.SAVINGS_VIEW_ACTIONS_DESC: Use these actions to approve savings applications, perform deposits, withdrawals, or close the account.
GUIDE.SAVINGS_DESC: Manage savings accounts and long-term deposit applications.
GUIDE.SAVINGS_SEARCH_DESC: Filter savings account records by search parameters or specific statuses.
GUIDE.SAVINGS_CREATE_DESC: Click here to initiate a savings account application for a client.
GUIDE.SHARES_DESC: This page lists all customer share capital accounts. Share accounts represent equity investments in the institution.
GUIDE.SHARES_CREATE_DESC: Click this button to open the share account application form. You will need a client with a savings account in the same currency as the share product.
GUIDE.SHARES_CREATE_FORM_DESC: Fill in this form to submit a share purchase application. The account will start in 'Submitted and pending approval' status.
GUIDE.SHARES_PREREQ_DESC: This banner explains the required steps. The most common issue is a currency mismatch — the client needs a savings account in the same currency as the share product.
GUIDE.SHARES_CLIENT_DESC: Search for and select the client who will own this share account. After selection, the available share products will load.
GUIDE.SHARES_PRODUCT_DESC: Choose the share product. This determines the unit price, currency, and rules. Savings accounts will be filtered to match the product currency.
GUIDE.SHARES_SAVINGS_DESC: Select the client's savings account for dividend payments and share purchase funding. Only accounts matching the product currency are shown.
